command.mac:
cd ~
gh auth switch -u shivinate7
gh secret set MAC_RUNNER_READ_TOKEN -R shivinate7/claude-settings
command.powershell:
cd ~
gh auth switch -u shivinate7
gh secret set MAC_RUNNER_READ_TOKEN -R shivinate7/claude-settings

context:
Goal: batch macOS jobs run on your MacBook, as you ruled at 14:19 CST today (R58), so batches stop waiting for GitHub's macOS machines.
Problem (rule): the code is built (PR #2970, with the batch runner as an express merge), but it needs two things only you can add: the runner registered on your MacBook, and a repo secret that lets CI read the repo's runner list. Until both exist, every batch keeps using GitHub's macOS machines.
Based on (read): lane ci-batch-mac-runner reported both acts open at 15:10 CST; the PR body names the secret MAC_RUNNER_READ_TOKEN.
Departs from: main runs batch macOS jobs on GitHub's machines only — they run on your MacBook (label claude-settings-mac) when it is online.
Why yours: the runner installs on your MacBook, and the repo secret needs your GitHub login; this cloud session cannot reach the repo's secrets (measured 2026-11-12, gh api actions/secrets/public-key returned HTTP 403 from the proxy).

options.gain: Batch macOS jobs run on your MacBook as soon as PR #2970 merges.
options.how: 1. On your MacBook, open the new-runner page below, pick macOS and ARM64, and run its commands; when config.sh asks for labels, add claude-settings-mac. Run ./svc.sh install then ./svc.sh start so it survives a restart. 2. You asked whether the degen repo's token can serve: yes, if its repo access includes shivinate7/claude-settings with Administration: Read (widen it on its token page if not); GitHub never shows a secret again, so paste its value from where you keep it. Otherwise make a new fine-grained token with Administration: Read on this repo (the token page below). 3. Paste the command below in Terminal and paste the token when asked.
options.label: Register the runner and add the secret
options.lose: Some minutes of setup; one runner runs the three macOS jobs one after another (unmeasured).

options.how: Batches keep using GitHub's macOS machines; PR #2970 still merges and switches over whenever you register later.
options.label: Later
options.lose: Batches keep queueing for GitHub's macOS machines, as batch 103 did for 26 minutes.

reply: Secret done 21:08 CST: you set the token read-only on all shivinate7 repos and saved it as MAC_RUNNER_READ_TOKEN (relayed by the retrospective). Step 3 needs nothing more. Still open: step 1, register the runner on your MacBook with label claude-settings-mac. This item closes when you report the runner online.
short: Register the Mac runner and add its secret
title: Register your MacBook as the batch macOS runner and add its read secret
why: Batch macOS jobs move to your MacBook only after these two acts.
